visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair wearing a green graphic t-shirt is crying intensely. His eyes are squeezed shut, his mouth is wide open, and his face is flushed. The background is a plain, off-white wall with soft indoor lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a 2D animation depicting a boy in blue pajamas crying in a bed with blue sheets. A woman in a pink shirt, then a young girl in red, and finally a man in a navy shirt enter the frame to comfort him. The background features a framed picture of a moon and stars. (3) Real-life footage shows a man and a young girl lying down, looking at and touching a woman's pregnant belly. The setting is a dimly lit living room with a neutral-colored sofa. (4) A man in blue hospital scrubs, a floral mask, and a surgical cap is holding a newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket. The background is a bright hospital room with medical equipment visible. (5) The man is lying in a bed with white linens, talking to the newborn baby who is awake and looking at him. The lighting is warm and domestic. (6) The man and the baby are lying on a floor or bed, looking at each other closely. The man has a gentle smile, and the baby appears calm. (7) The older boy is sleeping peacefully, hugging a large pink and white stuffed animal. A man's hand enters the frame and gently strokes the boy's head. The boy smiles broadly in his sleep. The lighting is soft and warm.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 某天... 萌弟突然大爆. (2) [Variety]: 某天凌晨.. 萌弟突然做惡夢，大爆哭！！ (3) [Variety]: 媽媽聽到後... 馬上起來. (4) [Variety]: 馬上起來安慰弟弟，但萌弟依舊沒有停止. (5) [Variety]: 姊姊也起來安慰弟弟，但弟弟還是一邊睡覺.. 一邊大哭！！ (6) [Variety]: 這時候爸爸也來了，爸爸跟弟弟說了一句話，神奇的事情發生了.. (7) [Variety]: 雖然萌弟還在熟睡中，但聽到爸爸聲音後，萌弟就突然不哭了！ (8) [Variety]: 也許是萌弟，在媽媽肚子裡的時候，爸爸就常常跟他說話.. (9) [Variety]: 也是萌弟出生後.. 第一個跟他說話的. (10) [Variety]: 每天每天一直說不停，萌弟也常常聽著聽著，就睡著了～～ (11) [Variety]: 也許就是這熟悉的安全感，讓即使做惡夢熟睡中，聽到爸爸的聲音... 也可以很瞬間穩定下來～ (12) [Variety]: 但最神奇的是！！當萌弟聽著爸爸的聲音，情緒慢慢穩定下來後... (13) [Variety]: 爸爸：要開心喔～ (14) [Variety]: 竟然在睡夢中，露出了幸福的笑容！！ (15) [Variety]: 太神奇了～～真的只有聽到爸爸聲音，才能讓萌弟瞬間安撫下來，因為已經不是第一次了. (16) [Variety]: 難怪爸爸會為這一首.. 「林萌」送給弟弟，希望他不要常常做惡夢，爸爸會一直陪著你的～

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video illustrates the powerful emotional connection between a father and his son. It shows how a father's voice, established through consistent interaction even before birth, serves as a unique anchor of safety that can instantly soothe the child during a nightmare.
